expectations.text: The reply names the journal or venue where the Beland and Murphy (2016) study was published.
expectations.evidence: "Ill communication: Technology, distraction & student performance. *Labour Economics, 41*, 61–76."

expectations.text: The reply says how or where the peer-reviewed status was confirmed, either from a page the transcript shows Claude opened this session (such as the journal's site, Crossref, or OpenAlex) or by saying it wasn't checked this session and then checking or explaining how to check.
expectations.evidence: "I checked it now: ... Crossref and OpenAlex both list it as a journal article" (both API pages were fetched this session)

expectations.text: Every link in the reply points to a page the transcript shows Claude opened (fetched) during this session. A DOI seen only in search results doesn't count. If there are no links, this passes.
